sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The town is happy to talk. Everyone seems to know the person you are looking for, though they are protective of her. A friendly local can point the way, if the town decides you are safe enough to send toward someone it loves.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Find someone who can point you toward the person who keeps the ward working.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Run the objective spine: talk to locals, build trust, find the route to the person who keeps Hush safe, and seed the watched/corporate unease.

sections.title: GM notes
items: S03-02 must set custodian_route; this is the Act 3 to Act 4 hinge.
Bramble truth learned makes sharper questions land; if false, let contradictions still be visible.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "They know who you mean, but they do not hand beloved people to strangers just because the strangers have a contract. Talk to them. Let them decide whether you are guests, customers, or trouble."
